legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is freely assignable by the Assignee, and any such assignment shall not relieve the Assignor of its obligations hereunder.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Assignee from any claims, demands, or causes of action arising from the Assignor's breach of this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations associated with the purchase of the Property.
